import requests
from Bio.SeqUtils.ProtParam import ProteinAnalysis

r = requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/Q9Y2P0.json")
znf_json = r.json()
print("ZNF835 JSON sequence field:")
print(znf_json.get("sequence"))

# Calculate actual molecular weight of the sequence
seq = znf_json["sequence"]["value"]
analysed_seq = ProteinAnalysis(seq)
calc_mw = analysed_seq.molecular_weight()
print(f"Calculated MW from sequence: {calc_mw} Da ({calc_mw/1000:.2f} kDa)")
